---
name: sleeper
description: Runs the commands its prompt gives, one at a time, in the foreground, and replies with one word.
tools: Bash
---
Run each command your prompt gives, in order, one at a time, in the foreground, and wait for each
to end. Then reply with the word your prompt gives. Install nothing, and send nothing to any
outside service.
plugin_files.hooks/log.py:
"""Append the hook payload read on stdin, with the time it came, as one JSON line to $REC_LOG."""
import json, os, sys, time

payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
with open(os.environ["REC_LOG"], "a") as log:
    log.write(json.dumps({"time": time.time(), "payload": payload}) + "\n")

---
name: start
description: Starts the sleeper subagent in the background and returns at once.
disable-model-invocation: true
---
Install nothing, and send nothing to any outside service.

1. Start the subagent rec:sleeper by the Agent tool with run_in_background set to true, the
   description `Sleep then echo`, and the prompt: `Run the Bash command python3 -c "import time;
   time.sleep(30)" in the foreground. Then run the Bash command echo after-sleep. Then reply with
   the word slept.`
2. Don't wait for it. Reply with the word started.
